features: PoE: 802.3af supports 8 ports @ 15W; 802.3at supports 4 ports @ 30W; PoE consumption status, on/off control, remote reset
USB: front 2 x USB 2.0, rear 4 x USB 3.1 Gen1; 1 x UART (RS-232/485)
Intel Celeron J6412 quad core, 8GB RAM
Preconfigured with VIGIL Server VMS (v12 and above); Linux Debian 11 or Windows (-WIN models)
On Linux-based systems the monitor output is only for system setup and service/troubleshooting; remote client supported
Supported video codecs: MJPEG, MPEG-4, H.264, H.264+, H.265
IP PTZ support; multi-streaming support; IP audio support
Recording modes: motion, alarm, audio, analytics
Edge-based analytics with current VIGIL software: ANPR, perimeter and anti-loitering protection, analytics search
Third-party integrations: access control, alarm, ATM, POS, analytics
Also sold as recorder and camera kits (NVR-1U-8CH-SMBK / NVR-1U-8CH-WIN-SMBK)
